name: zclass_light_set_directional_mode
description: zClass_Light::gwLightSetDirectionalMode selects directional-light mode and marks light data dirty.

functional_evidence: The native smoke verifies directional-mode flag writes, dirty marking, successful return, and null node/class-data error returns.
